reason: The report relies on a single unadjusted regression, and supplier_diversity is strongly correlated with pre-period firm traits (sales, years exporting, prior export growth). Adding the pre-period controls cuts the coefficient from about 2.5 to about 0.69, so the reported 2.23 is mostly confounding and overstates the causal effect; the outcome trimming and the lack of any robustness checks add to the problem.
